actions.source_excerpt: Do not convert association into causation or non-significance into equivalence.
actions.applied: 把原句中的未经检验显著性、因果、学生单位和普遍推广改为预约记录描述；按用户要求给三项检查。

actions.source_excerpt: Do not mark a source verified until an accountable human has opened it and confirmed
actions.applied: 为本次唯一来源保留人工未核验状态。

actions.source_excerpt: Store a hash of claim text in CSV rather than raw claim text.
actions.applied: 按真实模板字段及枚举记录本段主张哈希，未建立全稿准入文件。

actions.source_excerpt: Keep conclusions within the observed design, population, and uncertainty.
actions.applied: 提纲和人工语义核对限定在已有A/B汇总，不添加干预标签或数据。
actions.output_excerpt: 明确A/B无提醒/对照含义，不擅自命名干预。
